title: Bishambhar Dass Challenges the Khalsa in Doaba

blocks.text: This hinge page leaves the Dileram affair behind and opens a fresh Doaba confrontation around Bishambhar Dass, the powerful agent of Dina Beg's widow. He appears with troops, artillery, and allied hill support, so the new episode begins not with covert theft but with a public challenge over territory and authority.

Bishambhar's message is blunt: the Buddha Dal must vacate the Doaba region if it wants peace. Instead of yielding, the Singhs receive the demand in congregation, take offense at the tone of the order, and answer by insisting that he should pay rather than command them.
The page therefore functions as a clean narrative reset. One cycle of betrayal closes, and another opens in which control of land, military prestige, and ransom will determine the next clash.
